messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER][payments] notify-adapter failing to deliver pages to oncall — 10/10 deliveries failed, suppression engaged. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.local/notify-adapter
ops-oncall: i didn't get pages, seeing alerts in #incidents feed. checking now.
maria: grafana -> https://grafana.redwood.local/d/notify?orgId=1 spikes in 429 and queue length up to 200.
kevin: logs show repeated upstream 429: `level=error service=notify-adapter err=upstream-429 status=429 msg_id=abcd1234`
sre-jamal: confirmed. adapter internal queue >1500, consumers stalled. looks like backpressure from sms-gateway; adapter suppression path is tripping and incident-bot gets suppressed.
maria: can we enable manual sms fallback for active incidents?
ops-oncall: yes. running manual fallback script for payments now. command:```bash
./ops/manual_fallback.sh --team payments --dry-run=false
```
ops-oncall: sending manual SMS to oncall group (starting with highest severity).
deploy-bot: initiating rolling restart: deployment/notify-adapter -n prod (pods 1/3 -> restart)
ops-oncall: doing `kubectl rollout restart deployment/notify-adapter -n prod` now.
deploy-bot: rollout started; will report when ready.
maria: tailing logs while restart goes: queue length trending down from 1500 -> 400.
sre-jamal: quick dig: adapter was dropping `Retry-After`/rate-limit headers and marking messages as suppressed; patch ready in PR #456 to pass headers and implement backoff queueing.
deploy-bot: rollout complete for notify-adapter-prod-1..3.
maria: looks good — backlog draining, upstream 429s dropping.
incident-bot: resumed paging for payments — 46 deliveries succeeded after restart. :thumbsup:
kevin: filing follow-up INC ticket INC-2026 and linking PR#456.
sre-jamal: hotfix cherry-picked onto release/patch and will be promoted to prod tomorrow with smoke tests.
maria: postmortem items: add alert when adapter queue >100, auto-enable manual-fallback after suppression>3m, add observability for propagated headers.
alerts-team: adding alert rules and runbook updates to backlog.
ops-oncall: created tasks and assigned. will monitor next 2 hours then handoff to morning oncall. thanks all for quick coord.
kevin: note for retro: consider circuit-breaker + backpressure metrics surfaced to oncall dashboard.
ops-oncall: agreed. closing thread after monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
